messages:
Sophie: heads-up: vendors pushed tentative cert windows for H100/H200/MI300/Gaudi. can we sync today to map announcement lanes and embargoes? :calendar:
Devon: ok, I have slots at 08:30 or 17:00 PT. early is better.
Lina: early works for me. include SI leads + marketplace PMs.
Raj: quick Q: do we want to soft-GA with a compatibility matrix or wait for full certs?
Sophie: proposal: soft-GA for H200/B200 where we have validated images; hard GA for H100/MI300 when vendor images arrive. Gaudi depends on kernel drop.
Devon: need marketplace SKU tags and fallback routing policy if hardware flaps. we can auto-route to Dedicated pools for 24-48h.
Lina: lab update: gaudi image queued, vendor ETA 2024-06-12. MI300 microcode still pending vendor signoff.
HW-Bot: [ci] gaudi-lab-image: queued (vendor ETA 2024-06-12).
Sophie: please draft a decision table (Vendor | SKU | Cert ETA | Announce lane | Comm owner | Fallback). i'll take comms.
Raj: i'll draft fallback routing playbook and legal check list for firmware embargo.
Devon: i'll draft SKU tag mapping and marketplace tagging guidelines.
Lina: sending calendar for 08:30 PT sync; agenda + pre-read included.
Sophie: perfect. post any vendor ETA changes here so we can recalc embargo windows. :thumbsup:
